description: This file is a Perl module providing utility functions used across the Git::SVN namespace. It defines functions for URL canonicalization, path canonicalization, QR path manipulation, and utility helpers for SVN operations.

methods.name: fatal
methods.description: Displays an error message to STDERR and exits with status code 1.

methods.name: can_compress
methods.description: Checks for the availability of Compress::Zlib module to determine if compression is supported.

methods.name: canonicalize_path
methods.description: Converts a filesystem path into its canonical form suitable for SVN API usage.

methods.name: canonicalize_url
methods.description: Converts a URL into its canonical form suitable for SVN API usage.

methods.name: join_paths
methods.description: Joins multiple path segments into a single path, intelligently handling slashes.

methods.name: add_path_to_url
methods.description: Appends a relative path to a base URL, ensuring proper slash handling and URI escaping.
